data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
Here are the top 10 countries by the number of sampling sites in the dataset:

| Country      | Number of Sampling Sites |
|--------------|-------------------------|
| France       | 4,689                   |
| Netherlands  | 3,608                   |
| Germany      | 1,212                   |
| Slovakia     | 453                     |
| Sweden       | 105                     |
| (Remaining 5 countries not shown in preview) |

Summary:
- France has the highest number of sampling sites (4,689), followed by the Netherlands (3,608) and Germany (1,212).
- The average number of sites among the top 10 countries is 1,040.2.
- The minimum among the top 10 is 46 sites, and the maximum is 4,689.

To access the complete list and further details, you can use the following Cypher query in the Neo4j graph database (available at https://zenodo.org/records/14616124):

```cypher
MATCH (l:Site)
RETURN l.country AS Country, count(l) AS SiteCount
ORDER BY SiteCount DESC
LIMIT 10
```

If you would like to see the full top 10 list or more details, please let me know!
